The eighteen doesNotMutate entries all resolve, but g19.v2/, g20.v6/, g23.v1/, g23.v2/, g29.v1/, g30.v1/, dr-103/, dr-103.v2/, dr-103.v4/, dr-105.v1/, dr-105.v2/, sarif-fc-nonauth-term.v1/ and sarif-fc-outfail.v1/ are not named. fixtures/g21.v15/ is also absent, correctly, because the speaker authors those bytes rather than leaving them unmoved.
advisories.whyNotAFinding: The block makes no exhaustiveness claim — authoredCatalog.standing scopes it to bytes that exist and digests recomputed from disk, and every path the list does name resolves. Omission asserts nothing false, which is the opposite of the CLAUDE-G21FXV15-S-1 defect just repaired, where inclusion asserted the existence of directories that were never created. Noted only because the S-1 repair puts this list under a recorder's eye.

observations.title: The successor is a minimal, targeted repair: the whole-document diff is the two findings plus honest provenance, and nothing else.
observations.measurement: Leaf-by-leaf comparison against the frozen predecessor yields two removals (the nonexistent directories), the predecessorV15 provenance block with its two review triples, three recordedInputs entries, five findingDisposition cells, one added doesNot entry, one substantive role rewrite, one purpose rewrite, the version integer, and eighteen speaker-token-only refreshes. failsIf, whatIsNotAuthored and summary are byte-identical to the predecessor's. This is the cheapest shape a successor can take and it makes the landing independently checkable.

observations.title: The unlabeled-Codex-finding convention is the one already carried by two dual-ACCEPTed artifacts in adjacent lineages.
observations.measurement: g19-leftover-join.v10 (recorded at D-334) uses findingDisposition.codexV7MustFixCopies 'UNLABELED. … identifierInvented false.' and codexV7MustFixPredecessorV5; g20-leftover-join.v16 uses codexV10MustFix 'UNLABELED MUST-FIX. Same class as CLAUDE-G20LJ-V10-M-1.' The subject's codexV15MustFixLastHeading is the same form. Precedent is what makes the descriptive key readable as a disposition label rather than a coined identifier.

observations.title: Both v15 MUST-FIX findings were the same defect at the same cell, so one repair discharges two reviewers.
observations.measurement: Claude CLAUDE-G21FXV15-M-1 and the Codex unlabeled MUST-FIX both located the defect at $.basedOn.d300.role and both named the same contradiction with $.purpose and $.basedOn.d334.role. The subject records this convergence explicitly at findingDisposition.codexV15MustFixLastHeading ('Landed with CLAUDE-G21FXV15-M-1') rather than inventing a second repair to look responsive to two reviewers.

observations.title: The repaired d300.role also picks up the stale anti-lockstep reference the predecessor cycle raised as advisory.
observations.measurement: CLAUDE-G21FXV15-A-1 observed that the role named anti-lockstep-leftover-join.v3 while D-326 records anti-lockstep leftover-join.v6 as the current DR-127 leftover remasurement. Because the MUST-FIX repair rewrote that sentence anyway, the version token was refreshed at no extra cost. Advisories travelling into the cell a MUST-FIX is already rewriting is the cheap moment to spend them.

observations.title: The authored bytes remain unique across the entire fixture tree and remain one octet from the frozen v11 payload.
observations.measurement: Hashing every file under docs/coop/artifacts/fixtures/ shows afa75181… exactly once. The v11 far-over prehandshake payload digest 67abdd72… occurs seven times, which is what basedOn and remainderAfterThisCorpus mean by 'non-unique'. The new witness differs from it in the final octet only (01 00 00 00 vs 01 00 00 01), which is precisely the ceiling-plus-one relation the mutation text claims, and is why 'does not reuse the 16777216 prefix' is a real distinction rather than a formality.

observations.title: The dispatch's 'file 08' is docs/v2/architecture/08-decision-and-readiness-register.md; the similarly numbered file under docs/coop/architecture/ is a different document.
observations.measurement: docs/v2/architecture/08-decision-and-readiness-register.md = e503b75b… (the dispatched digest, file08Pin.sha256 and recordedInputs). docs/coop/architecture/08-surfaces-and-topology.md = f2a0f623… and is not referenced by the subject. I resolved the identity by digest before treating the dispatch value as live, so no OBJECT is owed on a file-08 mismatch that is really a file-identity ambiguity.

independence: I resolved every claim from bytes on disk rather than from the dispatch prose or from the subject's own findingDisposition. I recomputed all 76 cited digests with hashlib, resolved all nine cited commits against git log subjects, substring-matched all four quoted protocol clauses and the occupancy passProperty against their source files, read the DR-G21 row in file 08 directly, hex-dumped the new fixture and the g21.v11 fixture, hashed the whole fixture tree for collisions and for the v11 multiplicity, stat-ed every doesNotMutate path, read D-293's numbered decision list to check decisionItem 8, read g21-leftover-join.v14 obligations[3] to check the injection is a named remainder, and read g19-leftover-join.v10 to check the d334 role. The landing check was done by flattening both the frozen predecessor and the subject to leaf maps and diffing them, so the claim that only the repairs moved is measured rather than accepted. I compared the unlabeled-finding convention against g19-leftover-join.v10 and g20-leftover-join.v16 rather than against the subject's own assertion that no identifier was invented. I did not open docs/coop/artifacts/g21-fixture-corpus.v16.review-independent.codex.json, which exists on disk.
summaryForCoordinator: Recordable. Both frozen g21-fixture-corpus.v15 Stage A findings land at the cells they named, and the two reviewers' MUST-FIX findings were the same defect, so one rewrite discharges both. basedOn.d300.role is demoted to the sibling form and 'Last live heading at dispatch' now occurs exactly once in the document, at basedOn.d334.role, making purpose's sole-claimant sentence true on the file's own bytes; the same rewrite refreshes the stale anti-lockstep reference that travelled as CLAUDE-G21FXV15-A-1. authoredCatalog.doesNotMutate drops fixtures/g21.v13/ and fixtures/g21.v14/, and all eighteen surviving entries resolve on disk. No identifier was invented for the unlabeled Codex finding: the disposition key follows the convention already carried by the dual-ACCEPTed g19-leftover-join.v10 and g20-leftover-join.v16, and the string CODEX appears nowhere in the subject. A leaf-by-leaf diff against the frozen predecessor shows the two removals, the predecessorV15 provenance block, five findingDisposition cells, one added doesNot entry, the version integer and eighteen speaker-token refreshes — with failsIf, whatIsNotAuthored and summary byte-identical, so no coverage bar or no-closure boundary was weakened while landing the repairs. All 76 cited digests recompute, all nine commits resolve, all four protocol clauses and the occupancy passProperty are verbatim, the platform list is quoted and ORDERED-EQUAL across G10 and G23, the fixture is 01 00 00 01 = 16777217 and unique across the fixture tree, leftoverDesignClosedIfAcceptedAndRecorded is [], and every dispatched attack fails to land. Three advisories travel as honesty work: the still-absent predecessorV12/V13 entries, the 'beyond this one-over witness' phrasing, and the non-exhaustive doesNotMutate inventory. None bars recording.
